meta.title: Baby Time — the nearest kindergarten for your child, in seconds
meta.description: Pick a verified kindergarten on the map, choose a date and time, and book a place for your child. No calls, no paperwork. For iOS and Android.
meta.ogAlt: The Baby Time app — choosing a kindergarten on the map and booking a time slot

hero.eyebrow: Now in Uzbekistan · iOS and Android
hero.title: The nearest kindergarten for your child —
hero.subtitle: Pick a verified kindergarten on the map, choose the date and time you need — the place is booked in under a minute.

features.title: Finding a place for your child has never been this simple
features.subtitle: Four simple things — and your day gets lighter.

items.title: Find it on the map
items.body: Every verified kindergarten near you on one map. Real distance and open slots, live.

items.title: Choose date and time
items.body: No monthly subscription. Book exactly the hours you need — today or next week.

items.title: Verified and safe
items.body: Licensed centres, staff credentials, real photos and parent reviews.

items.title: Instant confirmation
items.body: No phone calls, no paperwork. Your booking is confirmed in the app straight away.

how.title: Three steps. One minute.
how.subtitle: Open the app and choose the place for your child yourself.

steps.title: Choose a kindergarten
steps.body: Open the map, see the kindergartens near you, read ratings and reviews.

steps.title: Set the date and time
steps.body: Pick a day in the calendar, then a free time slot. The price shows immediately.

steps.title: Drop your child off
steps.body: Get your confirmation and bring your child at the time you booked.

panels.title: Every kindergarten nearby
panels.body: The map surfaces the closest kindergartens with open places first.

panels.title: Full detail on every centre
panels.body: Photos, licence, staff, prices and genuine reviews from other parents.

panels.title: You choose the hours
panels.body: A few hours or a full day — you only pay for the time you actually need.

panels.title: Confirmation on your phone
panels.body: Once booked, every detail and the route are saved in the app.

map.title: There is already one near you
map.body: Vetted kindergartens in every district of Tashkent. Drag the map and find the one closest to you.
map.note: Map shown for illustration. The full list and live availability are in the app.

points.title: 12 districts
points.body: Coverage across Tashkent, and the map keeps growing.

points.title: 1.2 km on average
points.body: From a parent to their nearest kindergarten.

points.title: Updated daily
points.body: Open slots and opening hours, live in the app.

safety.title: Your child's safety is our first rule
safety.body: Every kindergarten on Baby Time is vetted before it is listed. That condition is not negotiable.

points.title: Licensed kindergartens
points.body: Only centres holding an official permit are listed in the app.

points.title: Vetted staff
points.body: Our team reviews the qualifications and documents of every caregiver.

points.title: Genuine parent reviews
points.body: Only parents who actually booked a place can leave a review.

points.title: Secure payment
points.body: Payment runs inside the app over a protected channel.

items.quote: On busy days this is a lifesaver. In half an hour I found a kindergarten nearby and booked the morning.

items.quote: What I liked most was the detail on each centre. I checked the licence and the reviews, then went with a clear head.
items.name: Sardor

items.quote: Not needing a monthly plan is a huge relief. I only book the days I actually need.

points.title: A stream of new parents

points.title: Fill your empty slots

points.title: Free to start
points.body: Signing up and creating your profile costs nothing.
